card.justLive: {address} is working. Take a look at it, then tell us it is right below.

ready.body: Take a look at it, then tell us it is right in your settings.

confirm.heading: Take a look, then tell us it is right

turnOff.carriesOn: This continues exactly as it is, and is where your QR code sends people:

cloudflare.proxy: Set “Proxy status” to “DNS only” — the cloud beside it must be gray, not orange.

123reg.value: Put the second value below in “Value”, and add a period to the end of it.
123reg.caveat: 123 Reg needs a period at the end of the second value or it will not work.

instructionsEmail.introAt: We are putting {truckName}’s live schedule on {address}, and it needs one record added to our domain at {provider}.
instructionsEmail.introHolder: We are putting {truckName}’s live schedule on {address}, and it needs one record added to our domain with whoever holds our domain.
instructionsEmail.pointsAt: The page it points at shows where we are serving next and keeps itself up to date.

liveEmail.body: Your schedule is now showing at your own address. Take a look at it and check it is right: open {address}, make sure the events are yours and the dates look correct.
